text:
ryan: starting staged rollout for oracle-gen v4.1.2-hotfix. plan: 5% -> 20% over 20m. target region: eu-west-2. change window 02:00-04:00 UTC. rollout id: rl-2026-03-21-02

deploy-bot: rollout rl-2026-03-21-02 initiated: routing 5% of /v2/embed traffic to v4.1.2-hotfix.

leah: smoke harness kicking off. I'll monitor embed throughput and p99.

nozomi: running quick QA checklist: auth, embed, reranker.

eve: seeing a small spike in p99 embed latency (+210ms) on two nodes in eu-west-2b. errors still low.

leah: I can see corresponding Redis RESP errors and connection churn on those nodes. tagging logs.

ryan: hold expansion at 5% until we understand root cause. pls paste logs and any heap/conn metrics.

nozomi: log excerpt from node eu-west-2b-03:
```
WARN redis: read timeout (i/o) host=redis-eu-2b-03:6379 conn-367
ERR transport: connection reset by peer
METRIC redis_conn_open 142 -> 986 (1m)
```

ops-runbook-bot: recommended actions: 1) pause rollout 2) direct-traffic pin for affected shard 3) trigger infra ticket with heap/conn dumps. pause/pin/rollback templates below.

ops-runbook-bot: pause cmd: `deployctl rollout pause --id rl-2026-03-21-02 --reason "hold: redis connection churn eu-west-2b"`
ops-runbook-bot: pin cmd: `routingctl pin --service embed --to-version v4.1.1 --shard eu-west-2b`
ops-runbook-bot: rollback cmd: `deployctl rollback --id rl-2026-03-21-02 --to-version v4.1.1 --confirm`

deploy-bot: pause request received from ryan. executing pause...

deploy-bot: rollout rl-2026-03-21-02 paused at 5% (by ryan). state=PAUSED. note="hold: redis connection churn eu-west-2b"

ryan: thanks. nozomi/leah, run focused smoke against eu-west-2b-03 and collect capture of redis client stats. eve, can you check whether connection pool size changed in the release?

eve: checking commit diff — bump to redis client 2.9.1 and slight change in pipeline concurrency default (4 -> 8). sending stack traces and pool metrics now.

nozomi: collected metrics and uploaded trace: INFR-2401 created. attaching heap snapshots and redis slowlog. initial notes: increased client parallelism exacerbates ephemeral connection spikes under heavy fanout.

leah: QA verdict: failing to meet p99 SLO on that shard, recommend pin until we either revert client change or tune pool.

ryan: quick consensus check: pin eu-west-2b to v4.1.1 and keep rollout paused globally? react :+1: to pin, :-1: to continue testing without pin.

leah: :+1:

nozomi: :+1:

eve: :+1: go ahead and pin, I'll prepare a patch to cap concurrency.

ryan: pin approved. applying routing pin now.

deploy-bot: routingctl: pin applied -> service=embed route=/v2/embed shard=eu-west-2b -> version v4.1.1. routing change id rc-9933.

deploy-bot: rollout remains PAUSED. no automatic traffic increments will be performed.

ryan: updated changelog entry: "staged rollout of oracle-gen v4.1.2-hotfix paused due to redis connection churn in eu-west-2b; pinned affected shard to v4.1.1 pending infra mitigation (INFR-2401)."

nozomi: added QA block to the release checklist: re-run embedded gold prompts and stress harness on eu-west-2b after patch and before any resume.

ops-runbook-bot: rollback snippet (if patch not ready):
```
# global rollback to stable
deployctl rollback --id rl-2026-03-21-02 --to-version v4.1.1 --force --confirm
```

ryan: infra-oncall @infra-oncall — INFR-2401 assigned to you. please post troubleshooting updates here.

infra-oncall (bot): INFR-2401 acknowledged. triage in progress. initial fix plan: revert client concurrency bump in canary or apply per-shard connection cap. ETA 30m for first update.

leah: thanks — will standby to re-run smoke when infra signals. marking release status=PAUSED_PINNED and owner=ryan. keeping thread live for updates."
